components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Publish. Signal fill, ink text, including hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF5A1F; color: #0E0E0D; border: 1px solid #FF5A1F; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 44px; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FF5A1F; color: #0E0E0D; border-color: #FF5A1F; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0E0E0D; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card { background: #F1EEE7; color: #0E0E0D; border: 1px solid #0E0E0D; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; } .ds-card.ds-featured { outline: 2px solid #FF5A1F; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-label { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-title { margin: 0 0 12px; font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque", sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-price { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }

narrative.overview: This records the catalog shell that is already on screen. It is a flat proof sheet: bone paper, ink rules, and one signal mark. The sheet is a working surface for operators, not a marketing page. Density stays high enough to edit every offer and package without a second visual language. Corners are square. Depth comes from a 1px ink rule, not from shadow. Signal is the publish button, the featured package mark, the error rule, and the text selection. It is not a second theme.
keyCharacteristics: Bone is the page color. The name stays bone.
Ink is the text and the hairline rule.
Signal sits on ink for the primary button, including hover.
Bricolage Grotesque carries the titles. JetBrains Mono carries labels, prices, and buttons.

rules.name: The Signal on Ink Rule
rules.body: The primary button, at rest and on hover, is signal fill with ink text. It does not switch to an ink fill.

rules.name: The Bone Rule
rules.body: The ground is bone. A detector that calls it cream is still looking at bone. Do not recolor the page to satisfy that name.

rules.name: The Loaded Weight Rule
rules.body: Headings use 600. The app does not ask the browser to fake a heavier weight.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Do not add a drop shadow, a glow, or a blurred panel. State is a color already in the sheet: signal for the mark, ink for the focus ring.

dos: Do keep primary hover as signal fill with ink text.
Do use Bricolage Grotesque for titles and JetBrains Mono for labels, prices, and buttons.
Do keep text and controls at least 44px tall, and keep disabled buttons at full ink-on-signal or ink-on-bone contrast.
donts: Don't invent a fourth color, a dark theme, or a cream rename for bone.
Don't turn the primary hover into ink on ink.
Don't round a corner or add a shadow to make the sheet look softer.
Don't publish from this document. It records the shell. It does not change the catalog.
